_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, client assets, expense, trading activity and pre-tax margin signals with Schwab's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) ... engages, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as Schwab or the Company), in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services.' 'Developments in the business, economic, and geopolitical environment could negatively impact our business.' 'Our industry is highly competitive and characterized by aggressive price competition.' (FY2025 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); of the live themes in taxonomy_eras.json, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': CRYPTO names banks and exchanges, and the FY2025 10-K names digital assets among Schwab's industry and competitive trends and a crypto trading offer of its own, so CRYPTO is on the watch list; of the rest none names brokerage or banking, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, decarbonisation, electric vehicles or GLP-1 drugs, and the FY2025 10-K names cloud technologies only as a service its own systems rely on ('Cloud technologies are critical to the operation of our systems and platforms and our reliance on cloud technologies is growing.'), not as a way its own business is delivered or displaced, and the FY2025 10-K names artificial intelligence only as a tool of external fraud and cyber attack and among its industry and competitive trends ('Information security risks for financial institutions are increasing, in part because of the use of the internet and mobile and cloud technologies to conduct financial transactions, and the increased sophistication and activities, including the use of artificial intelligence technologies, of organized crime, activists, hackers and other external parties, including foreign state actors.' 'Industry and competitive trends including artificial intelligence, digital assets, private company securities and other alternative investments;'), not as a substitute for its own services; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21): these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Schwab

theme_watch.reason: Live: Schwab's own FY2025 10-K lists 'Industry and competitive trends including artificial intelligence, digital assets, private company securities and other alternative investments;' It names a crypto offering of its own: 'In 2026, the Company anticipates it will begin offering expanded client access to trading in digital assets including spot trading in select cryptocurrencies.' The stock trades at 20.0x FY26E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Schwab's brokerage and banking specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.4%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.6%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.1%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +36.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SCHW (retrospective, 2026-11-13) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.91x (56.5% downside to Bear $40.43 / +62.3% upside to Bull $150.92) | Adj composite 2.99 vs market 2.08: gap +0.91 [UNDERVALUED] | +11% above the EPP floor $83.70 (18x FY26E $4.65) | Conservative 2-yr case: +33.6% total (+16.8%/yr) | At 20.0x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $122.97 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +16.9% YoY in Q3 2026, forward revenues +16.9% (Q3 2026 revenue growth (no Q4 2026 guide)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
